description: This file defines FastAPI dependency functions for injecting a repository instance and an API key header into request handlers, managing resource cleanup, and providing flexible API key handling.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: Abstract representation of a data repository used within the application.

classes.name: SupportsClose
classes.description: Interface indicating that a repository supports explicit closing or teardown.

methods.name: Generator[Repository,None,None] get_repo()
methods.description: FastAPI dependency generator that yields a repository instance, ensuring proper cleanup if supported.

methods.name: str get_api_key(x_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Dependency that reads an optional API key from the request headers.
